name: Ammo Cart
effect: Until the next Astrologers round, each Ballista deals +1 :damage:, each First Aid Tent heals +1 :health_points:‍, and each Ammo Cart allows re-rolling 1 Attack die for all ranged units.

name: Annoying Lizard
effect: Each player must shuffle all Artifact and Spell cards from their hand back into their deck and draw the same number of cards from the top of their deck of Might and Magic.

name: Battalion's Stallion
effect: Until the next Astrologer's round: Each Hero gains +1 Movement.

name: Big Cleanup
effect: Each player must immediately discard all cards from their hand and draw the same number of cards.

name: Blue Sky
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round, all :spell: from the Air Magic and Water Magic Schools are cast at a +1 :power:.

name: Charlie and his Circus
effect: At the beginning of this round and the next one, each player can draw up to 3 cards from any Neutral Units deck(s) and Recruit one of them. The Players must still :pay: the recruitment cost and have the corresponding Dwelling in their Town(s). Shuffle the remaining cards back into their respective deck(s) afterwards.

name: Crag Hack
effect: For the first Combat this round, all :ground_unit: units gain +1 :attack:. The faction controlling Crag Hack can Reinforce Goblins for free once.

name: Crazy Wizard
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: The first Spell card player by each player is returned to the player's hand, instead of being discarded.

name: Dancing Imp
effect: Each player can Remove a Statistic card from their discard pile or hand to gain 1 Empowered Statistic card of the same type.

name: Dead Silence
effect: Nothing changes.

name: Destruction
effect: Each player who has a :permanent: card in play must Remove it and take 5 :gold:.

name: Disruption
effect: Starting from the first player, each player (if possible) can freely rotate 1 tile that has no Hero on it. No tile can be rotated more than once. If it is not possible to rotate even 1 tile, ignore this card and draw another one.

name: Elementals
effect: For each Neutral Unit deck except Azure, discard until you find an Elemental. Place each Elemental face up on top of its deck. When the Elemental is defeated in Combat, put it back on top of its deck. Discard the Elements when this card is replaced.

name: Explorers
effect: During this round, players do not draw cards at the start of their turns. Instead, each player draws cards up their :hand_limit:. Then, each of them may discard any number of cards. For every 3 cards discarded this way, they can Remove one Statistic card and replace it with an Empowered Statistic card of the same type.

name: Fancy Pixie
effect: Each player immediately gains 1 :positive_morale:

name: Fluffy Rabbit
effect: Each player immediately rolls 1 Treasure die and gains the rolled bonus.

name: Forty Thieves
effect: Until the next Astrologers round, whenever a player is about to draw an Event card, they draw 2 cards instead of 1, choose 1 to resolve, and put the other at the bottom of the Event deck.

name: Friendly Beaver
effect: If you draw this card on the first Astrologers' round, discard it and draw another card. Immediately remove all Black cubes from all locations on the map.

name: Gold Dragon
effect: At the beginning of the next Resource round, all players gain 5 :gold:.

name: Greedy Dragon
effect: At the beginning of the next Resource round, all players gain 1 less :valuables:, down to a minimum of 0.

name: Grim Warlock
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: The first Spell card played in each player's turn gets +1 :power:.

name: Groovy Satyr
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: Whenever you trigger Combat with any Neutral Units, you may choose a Neutral Unit card to discard and draw another card of the same tier instead.

name: Hero
effect: Each player can :pay: 4 :gold: to Remove a Statistic card from their hand and replace it with an Empowered Statistic card of the same type. Each player may do so twice, but both exchanges must be made on the same turn. Once a player makes the exchange, they place their faction cube on this card to mark the fact.

name: Isra's Friends
effect: Each player can immediately Reinforce a unit on the "Few" side at half the cost.

name: Judge Dread
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round, at the start of Combat with Neutral Units, the attacker can discard all of them and draw new Neutral Units.

name: Mages
effect: During this round, using the Spell Book token is free. You can use it even if you do not have a Mage Guild built.

name: Magic Tortoise
effect: Until the next Astrologer's round: Each Hero suffers -1 Movement.

name: McGiver
effect: At the beginning of the next round, each player can take 1 War Machine of their choice from the War Machines deck at not cost.

name: Merry Leprechaun
effect: At the beginning of the next Resource round, all players gain 1 :valuables:.

name: Multilingual Bron
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: Every time you use a unit's special ability that requires a roll, you can reroll it once.

name: Offense
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round, every card that provides X :defense: provides X :attack: instead.

name: Pirates
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: Every time you win Combat other than Quick Combat, gain 1 :resource_die:.

name: Plane Between Planes
effect: Each player can immediately Remove up to 2 cards from their hand or from their discard pile.

name: Plastic Tray
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: Units that take Defense roll no Attack dice to get +1 :defense:.

name: Profuse Growth
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: Your hand limit is increased by 1.

name: Restart
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: If you draw this card on the first Astrologer's round, discard it and draw another. Your hand :hand_limit: is reduced by 2 to a minimum of 4.

name: Rulebook
effect: During this round: When you trigger Combat with Neutral Units, the enemy's strength corresponds to the game difficulty setting one level lower than it actually is. If you difficulty setting is Easy, ignore this card and draw another one.

name: Sanctuary
effect: During this round, Heroes cannot attack one another. If you are playing a Campaign scenario, ignore this card and draw another one.

name: Scorched Ground
effect: Until the next Astrologers round, all :spell: from the Earth Magic and Fire Magic Schools are cast at a +1 :power:.

name: Society
effect: Each player gains :negative_morale:.

name: Spells
effect: When you are about to Search the Spell deck, you can perform Search(4) the Spell deck instead.

name: Swift Weasel
effect: Until the next Astrologer's round: Once per turn, each player can reroll a Treasure die or a Resource die.

name: Terrible Plague
effect: All players flip one of their units from the "Pack" to the "Few" side, if possible.

name: Unexpected Reinforcements
effect: Each player can immediately search the Neutral Units deck and Recruit 1 chosen unit associated with their faction for free. Each player still needs to have the corresponding dwelling built in their town.

name: Wandering Merchant
effect: Once during this round, each player can buy a War Machine as if they visited a Trading Post, but with a discount of 3 :gold:.

name: Whirlpool
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round, Whirlpools can be used without cost. Additionally, all Heroes can choose their Whirlpool exit tile instead of making a roll. If there is no Sea tile on the map, ignore this card and draw another one.

name: White Raven
effect: Each player immediately rolls 1 Resource die and gains the rolled resources.

name: Wild Debauchery
effect: At the beginning of the next Resource round, all players gain 5 less :gold:.

name: Wind
effect: Until the next Astrologers' round: All Heroes can continue their movement after entering a sea field from a land field. If there is no Sea tile on the map, ignore this card and draw another one.
